axes.name: Generalization
axes.notes: OOD AUROC under bias / noise shift (ID=0.997 → OOD=0.934, Δ=+0.063).

axes.name: Scalability
axes.notes: Empirical complexity slope d log(t) / d log(n) = 1.063 over N ∈ [200, 800, 3200].

axes.name: Data Efficiency
axes.notes: AUROC(N=50) / AUROC(N=1000) — measures how quickly the composer reaches asymptotic ranking quality (got 1.000 / 0.995).

axes.name: Reasoning
axes.notes: Fraction of correctly-flagged anomalies for which the symbolic channel independently crossed the decision threshold.

axes.name: Robustness
axes.notes: AUROC retention under additive noise σ ∈ [0.05, 0.15] (clean=0.996, worst-noise=0.959).

axes.name: Interpretability
axes.notes: Fraction of decisions accompanied by at least one non-trivial FibringComposer diagnostic (correlation, decorrelation, or domain-affinity bias).
